title: The build store records no images, so nothing can wait for them
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)
details: The status file lists a commit of a project that publishes images only once its images are published. The build store has no such rule, and no place to put images at all. A local build of sandbox is listed as soon as `make ci` passes, before any image of it exists. A sibling that pins it then names an image no host has built.
